medications.name: Ozempic (Semaglutide)
medications.instructions: Inject 0.5mg subcutaneously once weekly on the same day each week. Start at 0.25mg for first 4 weeks, then increase to 0.5mg

medications.name: Metformin ER
medications.instructions: Take one tablet by mouth once daily with evening meal

medications.name: Jardiance (Empagliflozin)
medications.instructions: Take one tablet by mouth once daily in the morning

medications.name: Lantus (Insulin Glargine)
medications.instructions: Inject 20 units subcutaneously at bedtime, adjust per blood sugar log

follow_up_instructions.description: Monitor blood glucose before meals and at bedtime for the first 2 weeks
Report any signs of hypoglycemia (shakiness, sweating, confusion) immediately
Schedule follow-up appointment in 6 weeks to review blood sugar logs
Continue current diet and exercise plan
